build: Summoner Druid (Ravens / Spirit Wolves / Dire Wolves / Grizzly, 1-99; optional switch to Fury Werewolf from 75 once the switch gear is in hand), computed from the D2R game tables
source_url: https://github.com/blizzhackers/d2data (D2R skills.json, skilldesc.json, runes.json, misc.json, weapons.json, armor.json, itemtypes.json, uniqueitems.json, setitems.json, hireling.json)
author: agent-computed from the game data, not from a guide

setup_legend.lvl 1-12 (Normal Act 1-2: Ravens, then S: Ravens from level 2 (prerequisite of Spirit Wolf), Spirit Wolves from level 6, Oak Sage at 7.
setup_legend.lvl 12-24 (Normal Act 2-4: Dire Wolves f: Spirit Wolf to 11 by 17, Dire Wolves + Heart of Wolverine at 18. Stealth at 17, Ancients' Pledge at 21.
setup_legend.lvl 24-40 (Normal Act 5 - Nightmare: Gri: Spirit at 25, Grizzly at 30, Dire Wolf maxed by 36.
setup_legend.setups: 'setup' is the stage the piece is first worn in. Stash pieces were read from the overlay's shared-stash view on 2026-11-19.
setup_legend.lvl 40-60 (Nightmare: Grizzly to 20, Mig: Grizzly to 20 by 51 (+10% damage to every wolf and the bear per point). Hire the Nightmare Act 2 Might merc. Jalal's Mane, Raven Frost and String of Ears are worn now and stay on after the Fury respec. Smoke is merc gear (the merc's armor); the druid keeps Stealth for its Faster Cast Rate.
setup_legend.lvl 60-75 (Hell: Spirit Wolf 20, Oak Sag: Spirit Wolf to 20 by 60 (with the Hell Den of Evil point) (+25% attack rating for Dire Wolves and the Grizzly per point), then Oak Sage to 20 by 75 (+5% life per point). From 75 with the switch gear (Cannot Be Frozen item, powerful weapon, Harmony, 2x Lawbringer, Smoke, life-leech merc helm) the Fury switch is possible (optional).
setup_legend.lvl 75-99 (Hell endgame: Ravens to 20): Without the switch the summoner goes on to 99: Ravens 20 by 90, then Arctic Blast 1 (prerequisite) and Cyclone Armor 8 (absorbs 124 fire/cold/lightning damage per cast). Endgame summoner gear: Heart of the Oak, Jalal's Mane, Enigma, Mara's Kaleidoscope, Arachnid Mesh.

stat_source: All numbers are computed from the D2R game tables (blizzhackers/d2data JSON, current with the Warlock class): skill requirements, petmax/HP/damage/synergy formulas from skills.json and skilldesc.json, runeword runes/types/levels from runes.json + misc.json (rune levelreq), base requirements and socket limits from weapons.json/armor.json/itemtypes.json, unique/set stats from uniqueitems.json/setitems.json, merc auras from hireling.json. Not from a build guide.

level_milestones.target: Summon Dire Wolf + Heart of Wolverine (reqlevel 18; Dire Wolf needs Oak Sage and Spirit Wolf)
Raven Frost (ring, reqlevel 45): Cannot Be Frozen; one Cannot Be Frozen item is required for the Fury switch
Summon Grizzly 20 (+215% damage for the Spirit Wolves, Dire Wolves and the bear)
Summon Spirit Wolf 20 with the Hell Den of Evil point (+500% attack rating, +200% defense for Dire Wolves and the Grizzly)

optional switch to Fury once the switch gear (Cannot Be Frozen item, powerful weapon, Harmony, 2x Lawbringer, Smoke, life-leech merc helm) is owned: 86 skill points (74 from levels + 12 from Den of Evil, Radament and Izual in all three difficulties). Oak Sage 20 (+125% life) by now. Otherwise the summoner continues
Raven 20 (31 hits each, 73-94 base damage +720% from the 60 wolf/bear base levels)
Arctic Blast 1 + Cyclone Armor 8 (Cyclone Armor reqlevel 12, needs Arctic Blast): absorbs 124 fire/cold/lightning damage per cast

targets.skill_points: 1 per level from level 2 plus quests: Den of Evil +1, Radament +1, Izual +2 per difficulty (12 in total). Level 40 = 39 + 4 (Normal) + 1 (Nightmare Den) = 44; level 75 = 74 + 12 = 86; level 99 = 98 + 12 = 110.
targets.summons: From skills.json: Raven count min(lvl,5), 12+lvl-1 hits, damage +12% per Spirit/Dire Wolf/Grizzly base level. Spirit Wolf count min(lvl,5), its points give Dire Wolves and the Grizzly +25% attack rating and +10% defense each. Dire Wolf count min(lvl,3), damage 7-12 (lvl 1) / 15-24 (5) / 37-53 (12) / 85-109 (20), HP +60% at 1 to +535% at 20, and each Dire Wolf point gives Spirit Wolves and the Grizzly +15% life. Grizzly 30-60 base, its points give Spirit Wolves, Dire Wolves and itself +25% damage +10% per level. Spirit Wolves and Dire Wolves are separate pet types, so 5 + 3 + bear + 5 ravens fight together. Pet level is the character level (calc2 ulvl), so the summons keep up without points; points add the synergies above.
targets.survival: Oak Sage: +30% life (+5%/level) for you, the merc and the pets (Oak Sage Aura); 20 points by 75 = +125%. Cyclone Armor (8 points from 92, after Arctic Blast 1) absorbs 40 + 12/level fire, cold and lightning damage per cast (124 at level 8), recast as it wears off. Heart of Wolverine (+20% damage +7%/level, +25% AR +7%/level) stays at 1 point: a Grizzly point gives +10% damage, more than Wolverine's +7%, and only one spirit is out at a time.
targets.respec: optional, from 75 (Akara's free reset of any difficulty whose Den of Evil reward is still unused; stat points are refunded too): Fury 20, Werewolf 20, Feral Rage 20, Lycanthropy 20 (460 s form), Rabies 1, Oak Sage 5 = 86 points. Only once the switch gear (Cannot Be Frozen item, powerful weapon, Harmony, 2x Lawbringer, Smoke, life-leech merc helm) is owned; without it the summoner goes on to 99. Details in the Fury Druid stage.

items.name: Stoutnail
items.setup: lvl 1-12 (Normal Act 1-2: Ravens, then Spirit Wolves)
items.base: Spiked Club (ethereal), in the shared stash
items.why: In the stash now; the druid hits along with the ravens until the wolves carry.
items.notes: Wear from level 5; before that any club/staff from Akara/Charsi.

items.name: Spirit
items.base: sword that dropped with 4 sockets: Broad Sword (48 Str) or Crystal Sword (43 Str), from item level 26 (Normal Act 5 / Cow Level / Nightmare)
items.why: +2 to every summon; runes Tal Thul Ort Amn are all in the stash. The weapon until Heart of the Oak.
items.notes: No socket quest for Spirit: the base must drop with exactly 4 sockets. itemtypes.json: swords drop with at most 3 sockets up to item level 25, 4 up to 40, 6 above. Broad Sword (one-handed) and Claymore (47 Str, two-handed) have at most 4 sockets, so any socketed one with 4 fits at every item level; a Crystal Sword above item level 40 can also roll 5-6 (no good). Shields need item level 41 for 4 sockets, so a Spirit shield is not possible yet.

items.why: Resistances for Nightmare; runes Ral Ort Tal in the stash.

tips: Level 1 has no skill point: melee with a club/staff; Raven from level 2.
Wear Stoutnail (stash) from level 5.
Spirit Wolves from 6, Oak Sage at 7; buy a 2-socket Hard Leather Armor at Charsi if the stash's Ghost Armor (level 22) is too far.
Pick up every druid pelt: +skills to Spirit Wolf / Dire Wolf / Raven are worth wearing.
Spirit Wolf to 11 by 17 (+25% attack rating per point for the Dire Wolves and Grizzly).
Hire an Act 2 merc with Prayer (Normal: Prayer / Defiance / Blessed Aim only).
Stealth at 17 (Tal Eth), Swordback Hold and Manald Heal from 15 (both in the stash), Ancients' Pledge at 21 (Ral Ort Tal).
Keep Radament's point for Heart of Wolverine at 18; Dire Wolves at 18.

Pick up white Broad Swords / Crystal Swords that dropped with 4 sockets (Normal Act 5, the Cow Level or Nightmare: item level 26+) for Spirit (Tal Thul Ort Amn, all in the stash); the dashboard's farm list names the bases.
Keep one Izual point for the Grizzly at 30.
No reset at 40: the summoner continues.
Hire a Nightmare Act 2 Might merc (Normal mercs have no Might); give it The Battlebranch or Soul Harvest from the stash until Insight.
Grizzly to 20 first (quest points from Radament and Izual too): +10% damage per point for every pet.
Wear Jalal's Mane (42) and Raven Frost (45) as soon as found: they stay on after the Fury respec. Smoke (37, needs Lum) goes on the merc.
Farm for Raven Frost from 45: the Fury switch needs a Cannot Be Frozen item.
Spirit Wolf to 20 (Hell Den point too), then Oak Sage to 20 by 75.
Hell has -100 resistances: Jalal's Mane and Ancients' Pledge give +30/+13 all, the merc's Smoke +50 all for the merc.
From 75 with the switch gear: optionally respec at Akara into Fury (see the switch note) and swap the weapon and gloves.
Staying a summoner: Ravens to 20 by 90 (their damage grows with the 60 wolf/bear base levels), then Arctic Blast 1 and Cyclone Armor with the rest (absorbs elemental damage; recast it).
Heart of the Oak (Ko Vex Pul Thul, 4-socket mace or staff) replaces the Spirit sword; Enigma (Jah Ith Ber) replaces Stealth when found.
